text:
maria: Quick note — short-chat CPU up ~11% after transport refactor. Perf shows __writev hotspots and tokenizer ticks.
cheng: paste perf top?
maria:
```
samples %  proc   so              sym
2400   32% hostd  libc.so.6        __writev
900    12% hostd  grpc_core.so     grpc_call_start_batch
650     8% hostd  host_tokenizer   tokenize_batch
```
alex: probable small-iovec explosion from new http2 framing. writev called with many tiny iovs.
sam: also seeing kv_evictions bump -> pretokenize may change key formats and churn cache.
cheng: quick mitigations: 1) transport-level iov coalescer (adjacent iovs < 2KB), 2) skip pretokenize for seq_len < 32, 3) kernel selector: force low-latency kernel for single-request short seqs, 4) stable raw-request kvcache key when pretokenize is skipped.
maria: prototyped coalescer + skip: local microbench short-chat (10k qps): host_cpu -14%, p99 -30%, p50 +0.6ms.
infra-bot: Canary started at 1764007830 (canary hosts). 30m summary: host_cpu -12.4%, p50 +0.5ms, p99 -22%, kv_evictions/min -25%, transport.iov_coalesced: 12.8k, ingress.preparse_skipped: 9.4k.
alex: plan: land small patchset behind toggles and roll Dedicated -> Hosted. raj: I'll take kvcache key change. sam: I'll add dashboards/alerts.
maria: PRs incoming, tagging @eng-sre for rollout.
cheng: "+1"
